resources.string: Gaku needs permission to display over other apps
Notifications are off, so Gaku\'s notification controls are hidden. Use the buttons here or Gaku\'s Quick Settings tile.
If Android asks what to share, choose the entire screen. Sharing one app only reads that app while it fills the screen.
Type the address of an Ollama server and tap Connect. Until then, Translate opens Google Translate.
The server has no models. Pull one with \"ollama pull\", then Connect again.
Text goes to this server unencrypted. Use https:// if it supports it.
Translate and Ask use %1$s. Text is only sent when you tap them.
Install AnkiDroid to add the words you look up to an Anki deck.
Gaku can add the words you look up to an AnkiDroid deck, with the text they\'re in. It needs AnkiDroid\'s permission for that.
AnkiDroid\'s permission was declined, so Gaku can\'t add cards.
AnkiDroid\'s permission was declined. To add cards, allow it in Gaku\'s app settings, under Permissions.
Can\'t read AnkiDroid\'s decks. Open AnkiDroid once, then come back here.
Anki, in the results, adds the word you looked up to %1$s.
